## Description

Dynamically adjusts Bollinger/Keltner band width using rolling fractional Hurst exponents calculated via continuous wavelet transforms to scale mean-reversion sensitivity.

## Where it may fit

Transitioning regimes between trending and mean-reverting price action in liquid ETF and forex markets.

## Vehicles

Statistical arbitrage funds, systematic trading desks.

## Required data

High-frequency OHLCV bars, wavelet filter coefficients, rolling price variance series.

## Caveats

Requires robust fractional differencing windows to prevent look-ahead bias during Hurst calculations.
